v1 97.058/97.058. CONCRETE HUM: reese-led liquid at 174 bpm in G minor. The lead is a living reese, warm and moving rather than a neuro snarl.
- The reese sings a gliding riff in 3+3+2 sixteenths. On top of its own churn, its filter breathes on 3- and 5-bar song-time LFOs and a notch sweeps it every 7 bars (No Floor's throb, brought to liquid), so no two bars sound the same. It ducks under the kick.
- A pad and sparse Rhodes stabs frame it: Gm9 Ebmaj9 Cm9 D7(b9), four bars each.
- A different amen roller (the second kick on the a-of-3, so it leans) over a clean kick and snare.
- A half-time break where the reese is drawn out, a note a bar.
- An octave-up counter-reese in the second drop.
True-peak master (true_peak: true): -12.2 LUFS, TP -1.19 dBTP, longest pinned run 1 (levels.py). (Not queued.)
next: Ears on the reese's notch depth and the counter-reese level. Flow in from t6 (2.9: t6 ends near silence).
